# Crealize

> Crealize LLC is a Tokyo-based independent product studio. We carry products
> from 0 to 1 — validate, build, ship, polish. Brand: "Creative × Realize —
> transforming imagination into reality."

Contact: support@crealize.llc
Languages: English (/), 日本語 (/ja/), 繁體中文 (/zh/)

## Shipped products

- PurityLens — AI skincare-ingredient safety scanner: photo → OCR → AI safety verdict (Flutter, AI OCR, serverless API)
- Fudeto — daily one-stroke puzzle game (Flutter, puzzle generator, serverless API)
- Kichitto — receipt capture for solo founders: photo → AI OCR → auto-filed to Google Drive + Sheets (Flutter, Gemini AI, Google Workspace API)
- QiFlux — quiet, privacy-first cycle tracker; data stays on device (Flutter, Riverpod, local-first)
- moonpacket — crypto red packets for Telegram communities; non-custodial, USDT / TON / SOL / ETH (Telegram Mini App, multi-chain) — https://moonpacket.com/

## In development

- iDokuta — multilingual telehealth for foreigners in Japan; realtime-translation consultations in 6 languages (Flutter)
- Mairi — daily personal health record × hospital integration (Flutter, Next.js, LINE integration)
- Tendo — daily Hamiltonian-path puzzle, Fudeto's sister title (vanilla JS web)

## Method

Validate → Build → Ship → Polish.
Engineering principles: atomicity (one change, one meaning), explicit dependencies,
module boundaries, type-safe by default, zero-dependency bias, code as craft.

## Hiring

Remote-first, Tokyo HQ. Roles: Design, Engineering, Growth.
